age.evidence: A total of 56 adult male Wistar Han rats (Charles River, Göttingen, Germany; 250-350 g) were used in the experiment.

sex.evidence: A total of 56 adult male Wistar Han rats

dosing.evidence: The PSI dose of 0.05 mg/kg was determined and prepared according to the method described by Killerich et al. (2023)... This model was designed to replicate human PSI microdosing regimens... control animals received the appropriate volume of 0.9% NaCl. Over a period of 21 days, PSI was administered subcutaneously to the treated group of animals every other day.

handling.evidence: Prior to the start of the experiment, the rats were habituated to handling over a period of three days.

group_housing.evidence: The animals were housed in groups of four in animal rooms under controlled and monitored conditions

assays.assay_name: Prepulse Inhibition of Acoustic Startle Response (ASR/PPI)
assays.assay_description: SR-LAB startle chambers with rats in Plexiglas cylinders; 5-min acclimation to 65 dB background, then 20 trials each of pulse-alone (120 dB) and prepulse+pulse (70, 75, 80, 85 dB prepulses, 100 ms ISI), 20-s ITI. %PPI per prepulse intensity and average startle amplitude measured at 2 h (all 56 rats) and 6 days (second cohort) after the final psilocybin dose.

application_type.evidence: Over a period of 21 days, PSI was administered subcutaneously to the treated group of animals every other day

setup_habituation.evidence: Only within-session acclimation reported: 'Prior to the experimental session, the animals underwent a 5-min acclimation period to the background noise (65 dB).'

setup_restrain.evidence: eight sound-attenuated and ventilated chambers in which the animals were placed in Plexiglas cylinders

food_restriction.evidence: Animals tested in Plexiglas cylinders within startle chambers; no food in apparatus

water_restriction.evidence: Animals tested in Plexiglas cylinders within startle chambers; no water in apparatus

time_to_assay.evidence: PPI of the startle response was measured 2 h and 6 days after the last dose of PSI.

sample_size.evidence: All 56 animals underwent the ASR test two hours after the final psilocybin administration... Data are presented as the mean ± SEM (n = 14 per group).

outcomes.summary: Psilocybin microdosing (0.05 mg/kg s.c. every other day for 21 days) did not affect %PPI at any prepulse intensity or average startle amplitude at 2 h or 6 days after the last dose.
outcomes.statistics: PPI: prepulse intensity F(3, 204) = 1.74, p < 0.0001; prepulse x treatment x time F(9, 204) = 0.37, p = 0.947; treatment x time F(3, 204) = 1.74, p = 0.1601. AVG: treatment F(1, 52) = 1.002, p = 0.3214; time F(1, 52) = 0.2307, p = 0.6330; treatment x time F(1, 52) = 0.6163, p = 0.4360
outcomes.evidence: Thus, PSI did not affect the PPI at any intensity of prepulse and at any time points (Fig. 2A). ... There was no differences between AVG of groups

B1_num_measures.evidence: %PPI reported at prepulse intensities of 70, 75, 80 and 85 dB (Fig. 2A) plus 'The average startle amplitude (AVG) was also analysed' (Fig. 2B)

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: The final result was expressed as the mean amplitude from the entire session.

B4_ethological.evidence: PPI startle magnitude is not an ethological behaviour per rubric

B5_social.evidence: Individual sensorimotor gating test; no social component

B6_cognitive.evidence: Sensorimotor gating, not a learned/cognitive task

B7_automated_classification.evidence: The animal's motor response was recorded by a piezoelectric sensor (SR-LAB system)

E1_environment_type.evidence: SR-LAB system... sound-attenuated and ventilated chambers in which the animals were placed in Plexiglas cylinders

E6_spatial.evidence: animals were placed in Plexiglas cylinders

E7_social_context.evidence: animals were placed in Plexiglas cylinders (one per chamber)

D1_continuity.evidence: PPI of the startle response was measured 2 h and 6 days after the last dose of PSI.

D2_session_duration.evidence: 5-min acclimation period... 20 trials of each type [5 types] were presented with an inter-trial interval (ITI) of 20 s (≈38 min total)

D3_recording_days.evidence: All 56 animals underwent the ASR test two hours after the final psilocybin administration... the ASR test was repeated six days after the final treatment

D5_followup.evidence: the ASR test was repeated six days after the final treatment

assays.assay_description: Dimly lit (18 lx) black Plexiglas arena (60 × 60 × 30 cm); 10-min empty-arena habituation 24 h before; 5-min training with two identical objects, 1-h ITI, 5-min recognition session with familiar and novel object. Exploration (sniffing/nose touching) times and discrimination index measured 1 and 7 days after final psilocybin dose (second cohort).

application_type.evidence: Over a period of 21 days, PSI was administered subcutaneously to the treated group of animals every other day

setup_habituation.evidence: Twenty-four hours prior to the training session, animals were habituated to the arena (in the absence of objects) for 10 min.

setup_restrain.evidence: Rats were initially placed in the centre of the arena.

food_restriction.evidence: Open Plexiglas arena; no food in apparatus

water_restriction.evidence: Open Plexiglas arena; no water in apparatus

time_to_assay.evidence: Recognition memory was analysed 1 and 7 days after the last dose of PSI.

sample_size.evidence: The second group (n = 28) underwent the NOR test one day after the final treatment... Data are presented as the mean ± SEM (n = 14 per group).

outcomes.summary: Psilocybin microdosing did not affect the discrimination index or training exploration at 1 or 7 days after the last dose. PSI-treated rats explored the novel object significantly more than the familiar one at 1 day but not at 7 days, which authors interpret as a possible transient improvement.
outcomes.statistics: Training: treatment x object F(1, 52) = 0.1791, p = 0.6802; treatment x time x object F(1, 52) = 0.5969, p = 0.4433. Test: object F(1, 52) = 43.68, p < 0.0001; treatment x time x object F(1, 52) = 2.155, p = 0.1481; PSI novel vs familiar 1d p < 0.003, 7d p = 0.0759. DI: treatment F(1, 52) = 0.03702, p = 0.8482; time F(1, 52) = 4.026, p = 0.05; treatment x time F(1, 52) = 0.9899, p = 0.3244
outcomes.evidence: PSI administration did not affect the discrimination index [treatment = F(1, 52) = 0.03702, p = 0.8482]. PSI-treated rats spent significantly more time exploring the novel object than the familiar one 1 day (p < 0.003) but not 7 days (p = 0.0759) after the last dose injection

B1_num_measures.evidence: Exploration of objects A and A' in training (Fig. 3A), familiar vs novel object exploration in test (Fig. 3B), and Discrimination Index (Fig. 3C)

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Session totals only; no within-session time course reported

B4_ethological.evidence: Exploration was defined as sniffing the object and/or touching it with the nose.

B6_cognitive.evidence: the preference of animals for novel versus familiar objects provides a quantitative measure of recognition memory

B7_automated_classification.evidence: the resulting video files were analysed using Microsoft Clipchamp software

E1_environment_type.evidence: cages made of black Plexiglas (60 × 60 × 30 cm)

E3_bedding.evidence: the floor and walls were thoroughly cleaned with a 70% ethanol solution and dried after each trial

E5_enrichment.evidence: Only test objects present; novel objects used as the test do not count

E6_spatial.evidence: cages made of black Plexiglas (60 × 60 × 30 cm)

E7_social_context.evidence: Rats were initially placed in the centre of the arena (tested singly)

D1_continuity.evidence: training (acquisition) session... 5 min; recognition session (5 min); Recognition memory was analysed 1 and 7 days after the last dose of PSI.

D2_session_duration.evidence: two identical objects (A and A') were presented for 5 min... recognition session (5 min)

D3_recording_days.evidence: underwent the NOR test one day after the final treatment... followed by the NOR test on day seven

D5_followup.evidence: Recognition memory was analysed 1 and 7 days after the last dose of PSI.

judge_notes: Two behavioural assays retained (ASR/PPI and NOR); all candidates agreed. Western blot and qRT-PCR excluded as ex vivo molecular work.

PPI B1: candidates split (qwen 2-3/1, deepseek 4-6/2, gemma internally inconsistent 2-3/2). Chose 4-6 (score 2) since %PPI is reported separately at four prepulse intensities plus average startle amplitude; score matches modal score.
NOR B1: exploration of A/A' in training, familiar/novel in test, and DI counted as 4-6 (score 2), matching modal score.
PPI D2: session length computed from explicitly stated parameters (5-min acclimation + 100 trials × 20 s ITI ≈ 38 min) → 15-60 min, following 2/3 candidates; confidence medium.
PPI setup_habituation set to not_reported: the 5-min background-noise acclimation is within the test session, which the rubric excludes; no separate pre-test apparatus exposure described.
day_night_flipped = 'no' (modal): '12:12 light/dark cycle [6-18]' indicates lights on 06:00–18:00, a standard cycle.
Dosing schedule = microdosing (modal) given explicit microdosing framing (0.05 mg/kg s.c. every other day for 21 days).
NOR B4 = Yes (modal): object exploration explicitly scored as sniffing/nose-touching acts.
NOR time_dependent = no: no significant treatment x time or treatment x time x object interaction despite post-hoc difference at 1 d only.
